create_subcmd_class: create a SubCmd subclass that overrides run and setup_parser for a custom CLI command
use_cmd_decorator: use the @cmd decorator to register a new subcommand with a name and help string
register_subcommands: call add_subcommands to register all defined commands with an argparse subparsers object
override_run_method: override the run method in a SubCmd subclass to perform custom command logic with args
setup_parser_args: override setup_parser in a SubCmd subclass to add custom arguments to the command parser
